references.title: Strategic Brand Management: Building, Measuring, and Managing Brand Equity (5th edition)
references.summary: Brand equity built through brand elements: names, URLs, logos, symbols, characters, spokespeople, slogans, jingles, packaging and signage, chosen for memorability, meaningfulness, likability, transferability, adaptability and protectability (chapter 4).

stance.why: The brand record follows Keller's brand elements; Keller's 'slogan' is split into the enduring tagline (on the venture) and a campaign's slogan (on the campaign), as marketing practice does (EE-046).
